component-o.description-s: 4.5V to 28V Input, 2A Output, EMI Friendly Synchronous Step-Down Converter

cfgpins-ao.5c: EN UVLO divider (Figure 7-1): top to vin, bottom to gnd

cfgpins-ao.4c: VFB reference 0.596 V; feedback divider top to vout, bottom to gnd; 75 pF feed-forward across the top resistor

specs-o.en_note-s: internal current source: a floating EN enables (p3); 0.7 uA at VEN 1 V plus 1.55 uA hysteresis current above the threshold

en_source-o.table-s: 5.5 Electrical Characteristics, ENABLE: V(EN_FALLING) 1.1 V min, V(EN_RISING) 1.28 V max, I(EN_INPUT) 0.7 uA, I(EN_HYS) 1.55 uA

loop_source-o.table-s: 7.2.3.5.2 Output Capacitor Selection, Equation 14 and 'choose the crossover frequency less than 40kHz without considering the feed forward capacitor'
